gaps: Source gives no region names per fort and no per-fort tactics or guard-ship details; only one general method applies to all.
Per-fort rewards are not itemised; the reward text is the generic one for all forts.
notes: Capturing all 11 unlocks the King of the Castle trophy/achievement. General method (own words): upgrade the ship first; northern forts are easier and southern ones harder, and difficulty can be lowered. Sail in from the side, slowly, and stop to destroy each tower. When red weak spots show during enemy fire, hit them with the swivel gun and use the mortar. Brace while weapons recharge to cut damage a lot. Destroy any guard ships or they may flee after the fort falls. Once the walls are down, go on foot, kill all soldiers inside, and break the door at the top. After capture, send Kenway's Fleet to that region for passive missions (from the captain's cabin or Great Inagua Manor).
